facts.fact: The complaint filed 21 August 2026 states that the Tanzanian government shut down the internet nationwide around the 29 October 2025 election and protests; this is the plaintiff's allegation, with no end date given.

The complaint states that in the lead-up to the October 2025 election Tanzanian authorities blocked the platforms where Tanzanians could still speak freely, without naming them; this is the plaintiff's allegation.
facts.system: blocked online platforms before the 2025 election

facts.fact: The complaint states that in the lead-up to the October 2025 election the leader of the opposition was jailed on capital charges for calling for electoral reforms; this is the plaintiff's allegation, and no law is named.
facts.system: opposition leader jailed on capital charges

note: Abductions of critics and the Attorney General's vow to arrest the plaintiff are not arrests or charges for speech; the account takedown is a takedown request (other). Complaint text is an excerpt (introduction only).
